# QR code generator

Vendored qrcode-generator **2.0.4**, by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT license).
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@2.0.4/dist/qrcode.js
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
The LICENSE file is copied from the upstream repository.

Used by components/navigation.js to create the participant-access QR code
entirely on the viewer's device. No external QR service is called.

SHA-256 of qrcode.js: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`
